products: quarter, half and full beef shares

feeding_claim.verbatim: We give each CSA customer a choice of 14 day dry-aged 100% grass fed or grass-fed/grain finished beef.

pickup_locations: Greater Treasure Valley area (bulk share pickup)

notes: Angus beef sold as a CSA, with contact locations given as Eagle and Pleasant Valley, Idaho. Checked the homepage, how it works, FAQ and seasonal shares pages. Buyers of quarter, half and full shares choose 100% grass fed or a grain finish; the FAQ says grain-finished animals get grass hay, alfalfa and grain for the last 90 to 120 days, and grass-finished animals never get grain. Bulk share pickup is in the greater Treasure Valley, with delivery for an added fee. Smaller seasonal shares bought online include free home delivery in the Treasure Valley. The FAQ says the ranch never ships. Bulk shares were open for a March 2027 harvest when checked. Share prices and the ranch's exact location were not found.
